editorNote:
This listing is paused while we confirm whether Yurt Hideaway is accepting guests. On 1 October 2026 the operator's booking page returned a maintenance response, and its recently indexed text said bookings were closed until further notice. The Airbnb listing previously associated with the yurt did not open in our direct check. Do not plan a stay around this listing until the host confirms that bookings have resumed.

The operator's published description identifies one traditional six-metre Mongolian yurt in a private, fenced garden in Tootgarook. It describes a covered outdoor kitchenette and a separate bathroom a few steps from the yurt, reached along a paved path. There is no television; Wi-Fi is available. These details describe the accommodation as published, not its current availability.

The operator's published house rules say no pets and a maximum of two guests. Check the current rules directly with the host if bookings reopen.
